title: Coslovs: the about statement centred on ruled lines, script words inside it
note: About is one centred statement at 50px thin on grey rules: 'I'm an Art director working at the intersection of Design, Photography, and AI-driven content creation. I create Visual Concepts and Systems…', with the key words in Pinyon Script. Under it a single small red centred line, then contacts as a two-column grid of big thin names (Telegram Chnl, Instagram*, Email, Behance) with two small lines each. Worth reusing: letting one ruled, centred paragraph carry a whole section.
